description: What listens to every click sets timers of its own: an analytics flush 3 s later and a poll every 100 ms that changes nothing. An activation of a neutral spot of each copy shows them for the page's, so they are neither waited for to the end nor taken for something still to happen: the two links that only show a panel act as buttons and the button that shows and hides a part of the page without aria-expanded is a disclosure, all three likely as on a page without those listeners. The link whose own timer is due after 6 s is still info, timerPending.
